{{Family infobox|Leather Horse Armor;Copper Horse Armor;Iron Horse Armor;Golden Horse Armor;Diamond Horse Armor;Adamant Horse Armor|title=Horse armor|type=Item|stackable=No}}
'''Horse armor''' is mostly unchanged from vanilla: netherite horse armor is renamed '''adamant horse armor''' (and the same applies to nautilus armor), and horse armor can be recycled back into its material.

== Obtaining ==
* Leather horse armor keeps its vanilla recipe (using [[Sturdy Leather|sturdy leather]]), and can be crafted back into 3 sturdy leather.
* Adamant horse and nautilus armor use the vanilla smithing recipe (diamond armor, [[Smithing Upgrade Template|template]], [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]]).
* Copper, iron, golden and diamond horse armor come from chest loot.
* Metal horse armor smelts back into its material in a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]].
